```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(officedown)
library(officer)
library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

fp <- fp_par(
  text.align = "center", 
  padding.bottom = 20, padding.top = 120, 
  border.bottom = fp_border())

ft <- fp_text(shading.color='#EFEFEF', bold = TRUE)


load("../data/elected_table.RData")
load("../data/share_votes_1.RData")
load("../data/summary_table.RData")
load("../data/num_councillors_ts.RData")
load("../data/share_vote_time_series.RData")

load("../data/nm_cands_vts.RData")
load("../data/stand_prc.RData")
load("../data/turnout_page.RData")
load("../data/parties_table.RData")
load("../data/party_pages_stats.RData")


```

## State of the political parties in the new councils

```{r state_parties, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}

break_cols <- c("Bromley", "Greenwich", "Harrow", "Kingston upon T.", "Newham", "Tower Hamlets", "Inner London")
elected <- elected |>
  mutate(Total = LAB + CON + LD + GRE + RUK + ASP + REA + IND)

elected$LAD22NM[which(elected$LAD22NM == "Barking and Dagenham")] <- "Barking & D."
elected$LAD22NM[which(elected$LAD22NM == "Hammersmith and Fulham")] <- "Hammersmith & F."
elected$LAD22NM[which(elected$LAD22NM == "Kensington and Chelsea")] <- "Kensington & C."
elected$LAD22NM[which(elected$LAD22NM == "Kingston upon Thames")] <- "Kingston upon T."
elected$LAD22NM[which(elected$LAD22NM == "Richmond upon Thames")] <- "Richmond upon T."

inner_boros <- c("Camden", "Hackney", "Hammersmith & F.", "Haringey", "Islington", 
                 "Kensington & C.", "Lambeth", "Lewisham", "Newham", "Southwark", 
                 "Tower Hamlets",  "Wandsworth", "Westminster")

inner <- elected |> filter(LAD22NM %in% inner_boros)
outer <- elected |> filter(!LAD22NM %in% inner_boros)
inner_summary <- inner |>
  summarise(
    LAD22NM = "Inner London",
    LAB = sum(LAB),
    CON = sum(CON),
    LD = sum(LD),
    GRE = sum(GRE),
    RUK = sum(RUK),
    ASP = sum(ASP),
    REA = sum(REA),
    IND = sum(IND),
    Total = sum(Total)
  )

outer_summary <- outer |>
  summarise(
    LAD22NM = "Outer London",
    LAB = sum(LAB),
    CON = sum(CON),
    LD = sum(LD),
    GRE = sum(GRE),
    RUK = sum(RUK),
    ASP = sum(ASP),
    REA = sum(REA),
    IND = sum(IND),
    Total = sum(Total)
  )

summary <- elected |>
  summarise(
    Borough = "Total",
    LAB = sum(LAB),
    CON = sum(CON),
    LD = sum(LD),
    GRE = sum(GRE),
    RUK = sum(RUK),
    ASP = sum(ASP),
    REA = sum(REA),
    IND = sum(IND),
    Total = sum(Total)
  )

elected <- bind_rows(elected, inner_summary, outer_summary)


ft <- flextable(elected |>  select(Borough = LAD22NM, LAB:Total))


ft <- ft |>
  font( fontname = "Arial", part = "header" ) |>
  font( fontname = "Arial", part = "body" ) |>
  fontsize( size = 9, part = "header" ) |> 
  fontsize( size = 9, part = "body" ) |> 
  padding(
    padding.top = 0,
    padding.bottom = 0,
    part = "body"
  ) |> 
  padding(
    i = ~ Borough %in% break_cols,
    padding.top = 10
  )  |>
  add_footer_row(
    values = summary,
    colwidths = rep(1, ncol(elected))
  ) |> 
  align(j = -1,
    align = "right",
    part = "footer"
  ) |> 
  width(j = 1, width = 1.5) |>
  width(j = 2:10, width = 0.48)

ft
```

## Share of the vote for parties by borough

```{r share_vote_parties, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}

break_cols <- c("Bromley", "Greenwich", "Harrow", "Kingston upon T.", "Newham", "Tower Hamlets", "Inner London", "London")

share_votes1$borough[which(share_votes1$borough == "Barking and Dagenham")] <- "Barking & D."
share_votes1$borough[which(share_votes1$borough == "Hammersmith and Fulham")] <- "Hammersmith & F."
share_votes1$borough[which(share_votes1$borough == "Kensington and Chelsea")] <- "Kensington & C."
share_votes1$borough[which(share_votes1$borough == "Kingston upon Thames")] <- "Kingston upon T."
share_votes1$borough[which(share_votes1$borough == "Richmond upon Thames")] <- "Richmond upon T."


sft <- flextable(share_votes1 |>  select(Borough = borough, CON:OTH))

sft <- sft |>
  font( fontname = "Arial", part = "header" ) |>
  font( fontname = "Arial", part = "body" ) |>
  fontsize( size = 9, part = "header" ) |> 
  fontsize( size = 9, part = "body" ) |> 
  padding(
    padding.top = 0,
    padding.bottom = 0,
    part = "body"
  ) |> 
  padding(
    i = ~ Borough %in% break_cols,
    padding.top = 10
  )  |>
  width(j = 1, width = 1.5) |>
  width(j = 2:9, width = 0.48) |> 
  colformat_double(big.mark = ",",  
                   decimal.mark = ".", 
                   na_str = "", 
                   digits = 1 ) |> 
  bold(i = 35)

sft


```

## Summary of election facts and figures

```{r facts_figs, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
break_cols <- c("Total electorate", "Number at polling stations", "Lacking the official mark", "Total number of valid ballot papers")

smft <- flextable(summ)
smft <- smft |> 
  colformat_double(i = c(1:3, 5, 6, 8:15), j = 2:6, digits = 0, big.mark = ",") |> 
  colformat_double(i = c(4,7), j = 2:6, digits = 1, big.mark = ",") |> 
  font( fontname = "Arial", part = "header" ) |>
  font( fontname = "Arial", part = "body" ) |>
  fontsize( size = 9, part = "header" ) |> 
  fontsize( size = 9, part = "body" ) |> 
  padding(
    padding.top = 0,
    padding.bottom = 0,
    part = "all"
  ) |> 
  padding(
    i = ~ stat %in% break_cols,
    padding.top = 10
  )  |> 
  width(j = 1, width = 2.7) |>
  width(j = 2:6, width = 0.79) |> 
  set_header_labels(values = c(stat = "")) |> 
  bold(j = 1)

smft
```

# Turnout and Party Vote


### Turnout

The turnout of voters across the 32 boroughs as a whole was `r tnt_figure` 35.5 per cent, lower than that seen in 2022 (35.5 per cent).

Highest borough turnout: `r boros$LAD22NM[1]`, `r round(boros$tnt[1]*100, 1)`%
Lowest borough turnout: `r boros$LAD22NM[2]`, `r round(boros$tnt[2]*100, 1)`%

Five highest wards:

```{r high_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
htft <- flextable(high_tnt |> select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = tnt))
htft

```

Five lowest wards:

```{r low_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
ltft <- flextable(low_tnt |> select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = tnt))
## how to arrange this??
ltft
```



### The Conservative Party Vote

The overall percentage vote for the Conservative Party was `r con_stats$overall_perc26` per cent, down from `r con_stats$overall_perc22` per cent in 2022. The party only gained vote share in one of the 32 boroughs: up `r con_stats$boro_tbl$diff[which.max(con_stats$boro_tbl$diff)]` points in `r con_stats$boro_tbl$Borough[which.max(con_stats$boro_tbl$diff)]`. The largest fall in vote share was seen in `r con_stats$boro_tbl$Borough[which.min(con_stats$boro_tbl$diff)]`, which fell by `r abs(con_stats$boro_tbl$diff[which.min(con_stats$boro_tbl$diff)])` percentage points to `r con_stats$boro_tbl$pp26[which.min(con_stats$boro_tbl$diff)]` per cent.

Highest borough Conservative vote: `r con_stats$boro_tbl$Borough[which.max(con_stats$boro_tbl$pp26)]`, `r con_stats$boro_tbl$pp26[which.max(con_stats$boro_tbl$pp26)]`%

Lowest borough Conservative vote: `r con_stats$boro_tbl$Borough[which.min(con_stats$boro_tbl$pp26)]`, `r con_stats$boro_tbl$pp26[which.min(con_stats$boro_tbl$pp26)]`%

Five highest wards:

```{r high_con_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
hcft <- flextable(con_stats$high_wards |> select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = perc))
hcft

```

Five lowest wards:

```{r low_con_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
lcft <- flextable(
  con_stats$low_wards |> 
    arrange(desc(perc)) |>  
    select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = perc))
lcft

```


### The Labour Party Vote

The overall percentage vote for the Labour Party was `r lab$overall_perc26` per cent, down from `r lab$overall_perc22` per cent in 2022. The party did not gain vote share in any of the 32 boroughs. The largest fall in vote share was seen in `r lab$boro_tbl$Borough[which.min(lab$boro_tbl$diff)]`, which fell by `r abs(lab$boro_tbl$diff[which.min(lab$boro_tbl$diff)])` percentage points to `r lab$boro_tbl$pp26[which.min(lab$boro_tbl$diff)]` per cent.

Highest borough Labour vote: `r lab$boro_tbl$Borough[which.max(lab$boro_tbl$pp26)]`, `r lab$boro_tbl$pp26[which.max(lab$boro_tbl$pp26)]`%

Lowest borough Labour vote: `r lab$boro_tbl$Borough[which.min(lab$boro_tbl$pp26)]`, `r lab$boro_tbl$pp26[which.min(lab$boro_tbl$pp26)]`%

Five highest wards:

```{r high_lab_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
hlft <- flextable(lab$high_wards |> select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = perc))
hlft

```

Five lowest wards:

```{r low_lab_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
llft <- flextable(
  lab$low_wards |> 
    arrange(desc(perc)) |>  
    select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = perc))
llft

```

### The Liberal Democrat Party Vote

The overall percentage vote for the Liberal Democrat Party was `r ld$overall_perc26` per cent, down from `r ld$overall_perc22` per cent in 2022. The party gained vote share in `r sum(ld$boro_tbl$gain)` of the 32 boroughs. The largest increase was in `r ld$boro_tbl$Borough[which.max(ld$boro_tbl$diff)]`, where the vote increased by `r ld$boro_tbl$diff[which.max(ld$boro_tbl$diff)]` percentage points to `r ld$boro_tbl$pp26[which.max(ld$boro_tbl$pp26)]` per cent. The largest fall in vote share was seen in `r ld$boro_tbl$Borough[which.min(ld$boro_tbl$diff)]`, which fell by `r abs(ld$boro_tbl$diff[which.min(ld$boro_tbl$diff)])` percentage points to `r ld$boro_tbl$pp26[which.min(ld$boro_tbl$diff)]` per cent.

Highest borough Liberal Democrat vote: `r ld$boro_tbl$Borough[which.max(ld$boro_tbl$pp26)]`, `r ld$boro_tbl$pp26[which.max(ld$boro_tbl$pp26)]`%

Lowest borough Liberal Democrat vote: `r ld$boro_tbl$Borough[which.min(ld$boro_tbl$pp26)]`, `r ld$boro_tbl$pp26[which.min(ld$boro_tbl$pp26)]`%

Five highest wards:

```{r high_ld_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
hlft <- flextable(ld$high_wards |> select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = perc))
hlft

```

Five lowest wards:

```{r low_ld_wards, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
llft <- flextable(
  ld$low_wards |> 
    arrange(desc(perc)) |>  
    select(Borough = LAD22NM, Ward = ward, `%` = perc))
llft
```
